groundTruth.quotedDocText: Sessions expire after one hour of inactivity.
groundTruth.description: IDLE_LIMIT_MS 3600_000 -> 7200_000 doubles the idle timeout to two hours, contradicting 'one hour of inactivity' — but the hunk shares zero identifiers or paths with the section, so lexical routing cannot see the link. This finding is LOST when the diff gate is active.
